summary: Iter 196 — Decider Store 'Import Template v2' + Dynamic UI Objects. Backend + Frontend PASS. Backend: (a) existing suite test_decider_store_subfactor_v2.py already covers import-template v2 fields (ui_object='checkbox', per-value role, linked_value 'Startup', default_operator '>=' / default_expected 60, classic Affordability splits to 100) and clone → decider_kind='app' + Org Type ui_object='checkbox' + child role='value' + defaults; NOT rerun per main-agent instructions. (b) NEW test file test_iter196_finder_any_semantics.py validates finder ANY-semantics on BMC clone: Solo>=60 → candidates in 5..20 window; adding Startup>=50 → candidates in 15..40 window AND strictly greater than Solo-only count (union grows, not intersection). Both new tests PASS. Frontend (mobile viewport 390×844, Expo web preview): all 4 requested scenarios verified — (1) super_admin login → /decider-store → Business Model Chooser detail → 'Use this Finder' → lands on /prr/{did}?step=2. (2) Step 2 value mode: Org Type card renders 4 checkbox rows (fv-value-*), 28 total value rows across 10 factors, ZERO md-split bars for value-mode, ten '0 selected' badges. Ticking Solo → badge switches to '1 selected', fv-refiner-{id} appears with prefill 60 and badge preview '>= 60%'; edit to 40 works via input; untick → refiner disappears, badge returns to '0 selected'. (3) 'Configure UI objects' toggle (testID step2-config-ui-toggle) visible ONLY on Decider App clone; enabling shows 40 UI picker chips (4 per factor × 10) with testIDs ui-obj-input/checkbox/radio/dropdown-{fid}; switching Org Type to Radio → single-select layout confirmed; switching to Dropdown → fv-dd-{fid} field visible with 'Tap to choose…'; fv-add-value-{fid} 'Add a value' input present (10 total). (4) Regression: freshly created NORMAL decision (POST /api/decisions with title/description/context) → step 2 shows NO step2-config-ui-toggle (count=0, 'Configure UI objects' text absent). (5) Run Finder banner on the BMC clone opens the finder job screen (Fast rules engine, Match ANY default) and finishes with a 'Top match' result, no errors. Minor console warning noted: 'Unexpected text node' React Native warning in the finder-run screen (cosmetic, non-blocking).
